messages:
Leah (AE): heads-up — BlueHarvest POC experienced a wave of 5xx and some 429s during a fund demo. Ramp was ~500rps sustained for ~2m. They want immediate fixes and a checklist for future demos. @Tom (oncall) @Sam (support)
Tom (oncall): looking. Alerting shows repeated 'capacity_throttle' and 'overload' from gateway. Autoscaler kicked but pod readiness lagged ~22s. No prewarm/burstpool attached to this POC.
Sam (support): customer pasted curl: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rw-error: capacity_throttle
retry-after: 1.2
{ "error": "server overloaded" }
```
Lee (solutions): BlueHarvest asked if we can do a short-term reserved slot (1-3 hours) for high-profile demos and what that costs. Also asked about fallback/soft-failure behavior.
Tom (oncall): Dedicated/reserved avoids noisy neighbor but requires SRE provisioning. For short demos we usually: 1) enable burstpool if account eligible 2) pre-warm a small pool 10-15m before demo 3) configure fallback to a smaller model and client retries with jitter.
Sam (support): sanitized gateway snippet: ```[2026-06-11T09:02:12Z] req=bh-01 route=/v1/chat model=rwd-large-v1 status=503 reason=capacity_throttle q_ms=3800
[2026-06-11T09:02:25Z] autoscaler desired=10 current=2 provisioning=8 pod_ready_s=22
[2026-06-11T09:02:28Z] burstpool_remaining=0 prefix_cache_hits=9 miss=491```
Tom (oncall): root cause summary: provisioning lag (~22s) + continuous high ramp exhausted burstpool and overloaded gateway queue. Gateway configured to return 503 once queue_ms passes ~2500ms.
Leah (AE): customer asked for a short checklist to run before demos. Can we produce one they can follow?
Tom (oncall): checklist (short):
- pre-warm: synthetic load for 60s at ~30% expected RPS, start 10-15m prior
- enable burstpool for demo windows (ops request via sales)
- client retry: base 250ms, exponential backoff *2, jitter, max attempts 4
- fallback header: set `x-rw-fallback: rwd-small-v1` on retries after first 503
- reduce slice tokens/temperature if possible for demos
- if expecting sustained >400rps, request Dedicated/demo slot (SRE ticket)
- monitoring: watch queue_ms and burstpool_remaining dashboards during demo
Lee (solutions): pricing note for sales: we can provision a temporary reserved/demo slot billed hourly. I'll send an estimate to Leah; burstpool usage billed as consumption. Also offer a pre-provisioned Dedicated demo for runway.
Sam (support): immediate actions we performed: 1) enabled fallback-to-small model, 2) increased pod max_inflight to reduce head-of-line blocking, 3) kicked a manual warm pool of 4 pods. Error rate dropped to near-zero within ~90s.
infra-bot: manual-scale event: created 4 warm pods for cluster-bh-poc (id: cl-bh-009)
Tom (oncall): follow-ups/longer-term: improve autoscaler warm-start heuristics, add prewarm API for POCs, and consider per-customer queue threshold tuning if they accept higher p99 latency. Filed ENG-PLATFORM-842 for autoscaler warm-start.
Leah (AE): flagged customer security questions (SAML/KMS/compliance) to solutions/legal — not blocking right now.
Lee (solutions): add-on suggestion: provide a small 'demo profile' model variant that trims context and uses quantization to lower per-request cost and latency.
Sam (support): shared dashboards: https://console.redwood.test/customers/blueharvest/poc/metrics — watch queue_ms, burstpool_remaining, and pod_ready_time.
Leah (AE): I circulated the checklist and immediate mitigations to BlueHarvest. They've scheduled a rehearse demo next Tuesday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Tom (oncall): one more note: recommend client-side backoff + early fallback to reduce tail risk. If they want, we can run a staged load test in staging to validate the checklist.
Sam (support): closing: errors fell during last 10m of monitoring; action items assigned to Lee (pricing), ENG-PLATFORM-842 (autoscaler), and Solutions/legal for security Qs.
